result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also exceeds the fallback durations. It preserves the existing warranties and disclaimer because the disclaimer expressly excludes warranties set forth in the agreement. The redline is not strictly minimal because it adds re-performance as an additional remedy beyond the requested repair, replacement, and refund package. The new paragraph is generally clear, though the existing clause retains grammatical defects and the remedy formulation does not specify who selects among the alternatives.
